topic: Langfuse for DeepSeek Harness: OpenTelemetry-Based Agent Observability

key_points: DeepSeek API is OpenAI-compatible, so you can use the OpenAI SDK pointed at base_url https://api.deepseek.com
Import OpenAI from langfuse.openai instead of openai to auto-trace DeepSeek requests
Use @observe() decorator to group multiple generations into a single trace
Set LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY, LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY, LANGFUSE_BASE_URL env vars
Langfuse also natively integrates with LangChain, LlamaIndex, LiteLLM for DeepSeek tracing
Langfuse receives OTel traces on the /api/public/otel (OTLP) endpoint
Set OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT to the Langfuse OTLP endpoint and OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS with Basic Auth (base64 of pk-lf-...:sk-lf-...)
Include x-langfuse-ingestion-version: 4 header for real-time ingestion in Langfuse v4 (otherwise up to 10 min delay)
For Python/JS use the Langfuse SDK instead of raw OTel API; native OTel API for other languages
AI agents produce classic signals (metrics, logs, traces) but add unique challenges: dev experience gap, interaction-centric architecture, rapid evolution, framework diversity
Distributed tracing is the primary observability signal for understanding an agent's thought process (orchestration, chain of thought, tool usage, memory/vector DB queries)
OpenTelemetry auto-instrumentation is ideal because agent frameworks share uniform patterns despite diversity
Pair OTel with a storage stack (VictoriaMetrics + VictoriaLogs + VictoriaTraces) for a complete platform
OTel is the foundation for MCP observability with two sides: server-side (producer) and client-side (consumer) instrumentation
Dual-path telemetry: decentralized MCP server instrumentation + centralized token/context interception
Instrument the agent lifecycle and trace agent execution for distributed tracing
Practical implementation via TypeScript SDK instrumentation

OpenTelemetry became the LLM observability standard
Agents became the new norm and LLM evaluation became a product requirement
Lessons on adapting OpenTelemetry for agent/LLM workloads

stats.fact: Langfuse is an open-source AI engineering platform (YC W23) with ~33k GitHub stars and ~3.5k forks, integrating with OpenTelemetry, LangChain, OpenAI SDK, LiteLLM.
Langfuse v4 is up to 165x faster with real-time ingestion; directly ingested OTel data without the x-langfuse-ingestion-version:4 header can be delayed up to 10 minutes.
DeepSeek's API is OpenAI-compatible, so the OpenAI SDK can be pointed at base_url https://api.deepseek.com to call deepseek-chat / deepseek-reasoner models.
Arize Phoenix, an open-source LLM observability tool, grew from 20k to 2.5M monthly downloads in 2024 as OpenTelemetry became the LLM observability standard.
OpenTelemetry is a CNCF project providing a standard way to collect distributed traces and metrics; Langfuse receives OTel traces on the /api/public/otel (OTLP) endpoint.

angles: DeepSeek's OpenAI-compatible API means you can reuse the OpenAI SDK integration with Langfuse — minimal code change to add observability
